verdict.rationale: Paperspace offers self-serve signup and multi-GPU machines with up to 8 A100s plus NVLink. Separate machines can share a private network and shared drives, so a user could hand-assemble a loose multi-node setup. But NVLink is an intra-node interconnect, and high-end GPUs like the H100 need an approval request, which adds a gating step similar to a sales cycle. Missing for 10: a documented managed multi-node cluster provisioning flow, fast inter-node interconnect (e.g. InfiniBand/RDMA), distributed-training guidance, approval-free access to top-tier GPUs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
